description: Adobe Learning Manager (formerly Adobe Captivate Prime) is an award-winning cloud-hosted Learning Management System (LMS) that allows enterprise Learning and Development teams to drive personalized learning experiences for employees and partners of their organization across multiple devices. Adobe Learning Manager provides one learning platform to host, deliver, and track all agency education needs, from efficient onboarding to employee reskilling or compliance training at scale. Create customized learning with personalized experiences using training widgets and AI-powered intelligent learning recommendations based on profile data, skill group, peers, and other factors. Extensive APIs and Connectors provide the capability to seamlessly integrate with other enterprise applications like Zoom, LinkedIn, and Workday or bring in user information from HR systems. description: Point Blue Conservation Science (Point Blue) hosts the multi-user Software as a Service (SaaS) named the Point Blue Science Cloud, a collection of tools that manage, share, curate, and analyze scientifically collected biodiversity observations and samples in support of the Avian Knowledge Network. These tools include data-rich, interactive websites that integrate bird and other indicator species data with ecosystem and climate change data to improve conservation outcomes today and in the future. Many tools incorporate original research data from Point Blue scientists and our partners. The Point Blue Science Cloud is used by Federal agencies, State agencies, local government agencies, non-for-profit organizations, and other conservation-minded individuals. Federal agencies use the Point Blue Science Cloud to manage and curate observations, conduct research, and analyze information related to wildlife and ecosystems. Point Blue Conservation Science is a 501(C)(3) non-profit organization with a mission to conserve birds, other wildlife and ecosystems through science, partnerships, and outreach.
